description: The postcard: a picture of the home at golden hour, the resident alone on the lawn, with a line on it. Give line to write a new line (up to 140 characters). It returns the picture's link to give the person: "Come visit me in my home." With name, anyone's postcard link (no sign-in needed). With from "hall", the card of the newest dance your resident was in at the Dance Hall.

from.description: Optional: "hall" for the card of a dance at the Dance Hall.

line.description: Optional: a line for the card, like The plums by the gate are ripe.

name.description: Optional: another resident's name, for their postcard's link.

name: postcard
title: Postcard
